entities.name: Arni Metalbrow
entities.description: A human berserker from Kaldheim and leader of the Tuskeri clan on Bretagard.

entities.name: Tuskeri
entities.description: Clan on Bretagard led by its strongest, boldest member.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: Realm of Kaldheim where the human clans live.

entities.name: Njala
entities.description: Valkyrie who favors Arni and secretly wishes him to fight on.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who flew with Arni to deliver the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: Companion on the flight to deliver the Sword.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: Recipient of the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: Sword delivered to Halvar to end the Doomskar.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: Demon who attacked the raven wanting the Sword.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: Realm whose army is the Dead Marn.

entities.name: King Harald
entities.description: King with whom clan leaders agreed elves and humans must live in peace.

events.summary: Arni tracks rampaging trolls and defeats the biggest in a headbutting contest, gaining leadership of the Tuskeri and a spike in his skull.
events.quote: He found himself with a new title, leadership of the Tuskeri, and a souvenir permanently lodged in his skull.

events.summary: Arni, Kaya and Tyvar fly on a giant raven with the Sword; Varragoth kills the raven and Kaya saves them from the fall.
events.quote: the raven was attacked and killed by Varragoth , who wished for the Sword

events.summary: Arni delays the Dead Marn so Kaya can take the Sword to Halvar.
events.quote: Arni lagged, delaying the zombie army, and gave Kaya a chance to take the Sword to Halvar.

events.summary: Arni headbutts a Phyrexian during the New Phyrexian Invasion, lodging a spike and earning the name Metalbrow.

relations.quote: He is the current leader of the Tuskeri clan on Bretagard

relations.note: Valkyrie whose favorite human is Arni

relations.quote: Arni flew on a giant raven along with Kaya and Tyvar Kell
